text:
Elaine (Sales): Kickoff for Gamma Health pilot — goals, timeline, and sandbox access. Hi all, customer wants a 3-week pilot focused on clinical note summarization + PHI redaction. Ask: secure sandbox (de-identified sample data), clear eval criteria, and a cost comparison Hosted vs Dedicated. Timeline proposal:
- Week 0: creds, redaction scripts, security checklist
- Week 1: ingest + baseline evals (200 prompts)
- Week 2: tuning, UAT, handoff

Pricing note: Gamma expects a rough cost estimate for 100 req/s peak. Can we get a quick ballpark? @Sam (Solutions Eng) to own infra plan, @Priya (Security) to confirm questionnaire gaps. Marta, will you confirm sample data availability? :wave:

Sam (Solutions Eng): On it. For sandbox I recommend S3 presigned uploads + Private VPC endpoint (if they want on-prem style connectivity). Need schema for notes and one-row sample for redaction tests. Quick question: do they require pre-ingest redaction or runtime redaction with strict logging? From compliance, pre-ingest is safer.

Marta (Gamma): We can provide 10k synthetic but realistic notes by EOD Tue. No real PHI will be shared. Requirements: remove names, MRNs, SSNs, and free-text phone numbers. Pre-ingest redaction preferred.

Priya (Security): I reviewed the initial sec questionnaire. Missing items: KMS integration details, TLS certs for custom VPC, retention/erasure policy, and redaction verification logs. We need a redaction proof workflow (sample inputs + outputs) before granting access. Also legal needs DPA signed.

Devon (SRE): We can provision a Dedicated dev pool for the pilot. Need the customer account CIDR, S3 bucket name (or we'll create a bucket and give presigned PUTs), and whether egress to internet must be blocked. Metrics/trace dashboard will be available. ETA to stand up environment: 48 hours after creds.

Sam (Solutions Eng): For success criteria proposal (suggestions):
- Redaction: automated test F1 >= 0.92 on withheld eval set
- Summarization: ROUGE-L >= 0.55 and human acceptance >= 80% on 100 UAT samples
- Latency: p95 < 700ms for 1-2k token responses on Dedicated pool
- Stability: 99.9% availability during test window
I'll wire up an eval harness and 200 prompt set once we get sample data.

Elaine (Sales): Pricing: quick roughs — Hosted estimate per-token for this profile will be shared by finance, Dedicated baseline for small pool ~ $XXk/month + usage. I'll follow up with concrete numbers tomorrow and open an SOW draft. Need legal looped in for DPA.

Priya (Security): Also confirm: do we allow customer-managed keys (CMK) or Redwood-managed? CMK preferred for PHI. If CMK, we'll wire KMS access grants.

Sam (Solutions Eng): Noted. For the S3 presigned flow, here's a minimal ACL pattern we'll use (customer can host or we create):
```
# presigned upload example (CLI)
aws s3 presign s3://gamma-pilot/input/record-0001.json --expires-in 3600
```
And a small redaction checklist we'll run pre-ingest: remove patterns for MRN/SSN, mask names, drop free-text phone numbers. We'll provide a redaction script (python) and a small test harness.

Devon (SRE): Quick infra note — if they want to test Dedicated throughput, we need to lock a small burst capacity for peak load tests. Also rotating creds every 24h is standard for sandboxes; we can support longer if the customer needs it for automation.

Elaine (Sales): Action items: 
- Marta: deliver synthetic dataset + sample schema (due Tue EOD)
- Sam: redaction script + eval harness (due Wed)
- Priya: final sec checklist + DPA blockers (due Thu)
- Devon: provision sandbox + dashboards (ETA 48h after creds)
I'll draft SOW and pricing note.

sandbox-bot: sandbox provisioned in dev-dedicated-42. Console: https://console.redwood.example/pilot/gamma-1718800245 Credentials are in 1Password entry 'gamma-pilot/creds' (rotated). :white_check_mark:

Marta (Gamma): Thanks — I uploaded a 100-row sample to the presigned link for an initial redaction check. Will push full set Tue. :thumbsup:

Sam (Solutions Eng): Got the sample. Running baseline redaction now. Early note: a bunch of MRNs are in weird formats, I'll add an extra regex to catch them.

Priya (Security): I reviewed the sample output — looks acceptable but need a short writeup describing the redaction rules for legal. Please add a small audit CSV containing original_token_count, redacted_fields_count, redaction_hash (for verification).

Devon (SRE): Dashboard link: https://telemetry.redwood.example/dash/gamma-pilot — I'll grant dev and customer view permissions once legal signs DPA.

Elaine (Sales): Great progress. If anyone hits blockers, drop them here. Goal: sign off on the pilot success criteria and SOW by Friday. :rocket:
